name: Bridge Intro

band.style_feel: slow, laid-back 4/4 ballad groove; sparse drums in the verses, fuller kick and bass from verse 2, big straight-ahead rock in the outro
band.key: E major (bridge/outro shift to A minor)
parts: Part A: intro/verse 1 - clean arpeggiated guitar, very sparse drums
Part B: verse 2 - bass and kick enter, a bit livelier
Part C: chorus - fuller band, open and sustained
Part D: bridge/outro - loud riff, full-power drums (about 88 bpm)
band.tips: Tempo is about 84-88 bpm (automated estimates). Play the intro arpeggio cleanly for 2 bars before the Trio+ starts learning and keep time steady; the outro speeds up slightly, so record it as its own part.

whammy.tuning: Standard (E A D G B E) - unverified, from a user tab only
how: Keep your guitar in standard tuning (E A D G B E).
whammy.tips: I could not verify the recording's tuning (only a user-submitted tab says standard) and found no evidence of a whammy, octave or harmony effect, so the pedal is optional. If your ear says the record is slightly flat, check it against the recording.

originals.guitar: Fender Jaguar (1962, per Mixdown; a 1966 model per Ground Guitar)

guitar.position: Intro/verse: neck pickup (or neck+middle on a Strat), tone knob around 7-8; outro: bridge pickup for more bite
guitar.tone_notes: Bright, glassy single-coil clean for the intro arpeggio; a humbucker guitar will sound thicker, so roll back treble a little and use the neck pickup. Sources disagree on the exact guitar year and none confirm the pickups, so this is inferred from the models.

memo: Red Hot Chili Peppers - Under the Bridge: intro/verse. Frusciante clean Jaguar-style tone, light compression, bright and sparkly with some chorus and room.

name: Bridge Outro
memo: Under the Bridge: loud outro riff. Marshall-style crunch with mild boost, mid-forward.
